# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Jellyfin LXC"

variable "rootfs_size" {

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = false # Privileged for GPU passthrough
}

variable "enable_gpu" {
  description = "Enable GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding (requires manual setup via SSH)"
  type        = bool
  default     = false  # API token can't configure device passthrough, add GPU via SSH after creation
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "docker_host" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-host"

  name         = "jellyfin"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key

  # GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount media library (read-only access to library)
  mount_points = [

      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data/library"
      volume = "/tank/data/library"
    }

  tags = ["opentofu", "media", "jellyfin", "streaming"]

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
